claims: WrestleMania 42 streams exclusively on the ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited Plan in the United States.
Internationally, WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix.
WrestleMania 42 takes place in Las Vegas over two nights
WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET each night.
The pre-show for WrestleMania 42 is at 3 p.m. ET.
WrestleMania 42 takes place in Las Vegas, NV.
WrestleMania 42 is not on Peacock in the US.
In the United States, WrestleMania 42 is available on ESPN App/ESPN+ via the "ESPN Unlimited" plan.
